sentences.en: The pin pierced his finger and it began to bleed.
sentences.zh: 这枚针刺破了他的手指，开始流血。

sentences.en: Clerks with sticky fingers won't keep their jobs for long.
sentences.zh: 贪污的职员不会在公司待很久。

sentences.en: This ring is too big to wear on my finger.
sentences.zh: 这戒指太大了，不适合戴在我的手指上。

senses.zh: 用手指触碰(演奏)，(用手)指
